features._comment: Solo 3 features essenziali per convergenza ottimale

hmm._info_covariance: full = ogni stato ha propria matrice covarianza (migliore ma più lento)

training._info_window: Training window size (~7 days for 10min = 1008 bars)
training._info_min: Minimum samples required before first training
training._info_retrain: Retrain model every N new bars (~16 hours for 10min)
training._info_walk: true = sliding window, false = expanding window

validation._recommendation: Increase (0.7-0.8) if too many false signals

persistence._info_min_bars: Minimum consecutive bars before regime change
persistence._info_hysteresis: Extra confidence margin required for regime change

output._comment: Output file configuration for MT5 integration

regime_file._info: simple = solo numero 1/2/3, detailed = con metadata

backtest_file._info: File completo per backtesting con tutti i regimi storici

performance._info_cache: Cache predictions for N seconds to reduce computation
performance._info_parallel: Not yet implemented - for future use

backtesting._info_export: Generate regime for every historical bar

mt5_integration._info_interval: How often to update regime file (seconds)
mt5_integration._info_newbar: true = update only on new bar, false = update periodically

advanced._comment: Advanced settings - modify only if you know what you're doing

ensemble._info: Use ensemble of N models for more robust predictions (slower)

feature_selection._info: Automatic feature selection (not recommended with only 3 features)
